Trump Administration Actions Affecting Foreign Workers, Voters, and Environmental Regulations

The Trump administration's actions have faced legal challenges and scrutiny. A California judge has halted the enforcement of a $100,000 fee on H-1B visa holders, a move impacting foreign workers. Separately, a lawsuit alleges that a "quiet move" by the administration makes voting harder for Americans abroad, particularly those who support Democrats. In environmental matters, Chicago has joined a lawsuit against the EPA's repeal of a rule limiting power plant emissions. Additionally, the administration has begun sending $500 "Obamacare refund checks."
